mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees out at Fireman's Park, with a waxing gibbous moon visible in the sky.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Also, remember that the city now offers a rain barrel rebate program for residents, which provides a 30 dollar credit per 35-gallon barrel to help manage stormwater utility costs.
Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market on Tuesday.

Looking at the police report, on Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for her first O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

The Culver's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The restaurant is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
